The **I/O** group of the node palette has 13 nodes: 7 run, 6 cannot run yet or are deprecated.

| Node | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [CIFAR-10 Dataset](../io/cifar-10-dataset.md) | Can't run yet | CIFAR-10 Dataset is planned and not yet available in the runtime. |
| [Data Convert](../io/data-convert.md) | Runs | Convert datasets between supported table file formats. |
| [Data Input](../io/data-input.md) | Runs | Configure and load a project dataset through the Data Input dialog. |
| [Data Output](../io/data-output.md) | Runs | Universal data exporter - supports CSV and Parquet. |
| [Deploy to Node Editor](../io/deploy-to-node-editor.md) | Runs | Mark a dataset ready for Node Editor deployment. |
| [Export CSV](../io/export-csv.md) | Runs | Export Arrow table to CSV file. |
| [Export Excel (planned)](../io/export-excel-planned.md) | Can't run yet | Excel export is not implemented in PipelineExecutor. |
| [Export JSON](../io/export-json.md) | Runs | Export Arrow table to JSON file. |
| [Export Parquet](../io/export-parquet.md) | Runs | Export Arrow table to Parquet file. |
| [Export SQL (planned)](../io/export-sql-planned.md) | Can't run yet | SQL database export is not implemented in PipelineExecutor. |
| [Image Folder Dataset](../io/image-folder-dataset.md) | Can't run yet | Image Folder Dataset is planned and not yet available in the runtime. |
| [Kaggle Dataset](../io/kaggle-dataset.md) | Can't run yet | Kaggle Dataset is planned and not yet available in the runtime. |
| [MNIST Dataset](../io/mnist-dataset.md) | Can't run yet | MNIST Dataset is planned and not yet available in the runtime. |
